title: 怎样判断 Agent 的回答有依据？
subtitle: 用 Python 和 LangGraph 做一个有据可查的资料研究助理

title: 资料库只有两条笔记
subtitle: 编号用来定位，正文才是依据
body: 模型决定动作 → 执行工具 → 观察回传 → 继续或停止
最大轮次限制防止无界循环
保存此前对话；保留系统目标及近期有效资料
visual: Two equal spacious note sheets side by side, headed N01 and N02. Left sheet has blue circular-loop schematic and exact content shown below; right sheet stacked message shapes and its exact content. Do not draw bidirectional arrows between the two notes.

title: 先看真实记录，再讨论实现
subtitle: 2026-10-17 · 真实API历史记录回放
body: 调用上限不是精确费用上限
visual: Three horizontally aligned columns like a restrained technical fact sheet. Main emphasis: 4 and 3 large numeral limits, and model configuration. MiniMax-M3 appears only in the third column as recorded condition, not in title. Clear thin dividers. Bottom one caution phrase.

title: 谁决定去查资料？
subtitle: 模型选择动作，程序执行受限工具
visual: Clean left to right three-node technical flow: first box model with caption 选择检索词, second box tools with caption Python检索, third box model with caption 读取结果再回答. Arrow first to second labeled 工具参数; arrow second to third labeled 实际结果. Under it a compact source document N01 connected to tools only, not directly to answer. Make all arrows unambiguous.

title: 正常查询：回查 N01 原文
subtitle: 请根据课程资料解释 Agent loop
body: 原文：模型决定动作，执行工具，把观察结果交回模型，再决定继续或停止。最大轮次限制防止无界循环。
核对：循环步骤与轮次限制均有依据
visual: Two vertically aligned reading panels. Left labelled 实际检索: exact keyword and source text. Right labelled 人工核对: exact supported ideas, no extra claims. Small metadata at bottom of the body in one line. Use blue ruled line to visually connect source and supported summary.

title: 没有资料：承认不足也是合格结果
subtitle: XYZ星系的问题，没有对应的课程笔记
body: 资料不足：当前课程资料没有匹配内容。
当前资料无匹配 ≠ 世界上没有答案
visual: Simple technical path left to right: search query → empty list [] → a restrained amber result card. Emphasize exact short insufficient answer as central. Keep caution about no matches vs universal truth on bottom body line, no invented astronomy picture.

title: 同一轮，两个工具请求
subtitle: 模型提出一批请求，程序逐项执行并完整回填
body: 检索词、次数以实际记录为准
visual: Precise sequence schematic: model single box at top left sends two numbered tool-request strips inside one large tools group, strip1 会话记忆 memory → N02, strip2 memory agent loop → N01 / N02. Both results converge to model answer box labelled 最终引用 N02. Do not draw parallel lanes, processor concurrency symbols, or arrows implying parallel execution. Explicit caption 逐项执行. Include budget count bottom.

title: 真编号，也可能配上错误结论
subtitle: 手工构造的教学反例 · 不是模型真实输出
body: 原文 N01：最大轮次限制防止无界循环。
反例：[N01] Agent 能自动完成所有任务。
原文没有保证所有任务均能完成
编号检查还需要人工语义核对
visual: Split composition. Left blue source note with exact source text. Right amber outlined quote bubble with false sentence and large amber question mark. Underline unsupported words 所有任务 in amber. A bottom verdict explains the gap, clearly showing it is not supported. No celebratory check mark on the false sentence.

title: 真实失败必须保留
subtitle: 首次批次验证：空结果后仍出现假引用
body: 本次失败已保留；最终记录另存
单次通过不代表次次可靠
visual: Restrained evidence audit diagram: left card actual [] with label 实际证据为空, right card quoted small [N01] with label 回答却引用N01, clear amber cross and failed status beneath. No fake log screenshot, no made-up full answer. Bottom text: 本次失败已保留；最终记录另存. Do not imply reliability rate.

title: 用三行答案，检查一次回答
subtitle: 先自己判断，再回到记录核对
body: ① 模型选择了哪些检索词？
② N02在哪里实际返回过？
③ 哪句原文支持“不同会话应隔离”？
下一节：search_notes 接收什么，返回什么？
